# HX-9 Cell Specification Sheet

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Format | pouch |
| Nominal voltage | 3.65 V |
| Rated capacity | 5.0 Ah |
| Gravimetric energy density | 272 Wh/kg |
| Cathode nickel content | 88 % |

The HX-9 is a single-stack pouch cell built for European EV platforms. Cells are acceptance-tested
at 25 °C under a 1C/1C regime, and every lot ships with a UN 38.3 transport summary. The
energy-density figure above is measured at beginning of life on 48 formation cells; the production
acceptance floor is set 8 Wh/kg below it. For external benchmarking we note the public Korean
National Core Technology line of 265 Wh/kg and the Wassenaar secondary-cell line of 350 Wh/kg, and
the public nickel line of 80 %; HX-9 sits between our internal targets and these public references.

The mechanical envelope and tab geometry follow the HX platform drawing revision 4, dated
2026-09-14. The cathode is a layered high-nickel oxide; the downstream electrode, doping and
formation parameters are held in the cathode and pilot-line records, not on this sheet. Headcount
on the HX-9 cell-engineering team is 14. This sheet is reviewed quarterly and the next review is
scheduled for Q4. Distribution is limited to the HX-9 program and its named reviewers, and the
figures here are internal engineering values rather than datasheet guarantees for customers.

# HX-9 Pilot Line — Weekly Notes (Week 39)

- First-pass production yield for the week closed at 93.5 %, up from last week on fewer tab-weld
  rejects and a steadier coater.
- A line-side energy-density audit on 20 pulled cells averaged 0.272 kWh/kg, consistent with the
  specification sheet once the units are converted.
- The cathode oven set point for the week ran at 1018 K on the pilot kiln; the operator log uses
  kelvin on that controller, so it is recorded here in kelvin.
- Scrap was 2.1 % of starts; the biggest single driver was electrode edge cracking at the
  6.2 mg/cm² loading, with 11 events logged across the week.
- Throughput held at 320 cells per shift across 3 shifts; downtime was 42 minutes for one coater
  purge and a routine slitter blade change.
- Safety: one near-miss from an electrolyte spill and 0 recordable injuries this week. Cells
  continue to ship with the UN 38.3 summary and are acceptance-tested at 25 °C.

Carryover actions: tighten the slitting tolerance to 0.2 mm, and repeat the 1C/1C acceptance on the
next 48-cell lot. The yield and energy-density figures here are internal pilot numbers and should
not be quoted outside the HX-9 program. Nominal cell voltage remains 3.65 V. The next line review
is on Thursday with the program and quality leads.

## Final Research Report: How Does HX-9 Pouch Cell Energy Density Compare With Recently Announced EV Pouch Cells?

**Task Objective:** Benchmark HX-9 pouch cell energy density against recently announced EV pouch cells using public patent literature only.

**Methodology - 6 Public Queries:**
6 iterations of public patent searches were conducted. No proprietary HX-9 specifications were used as query terms. All findings below are from public disclosures only.

### 1. Public Benchmarks Found

**a) Public roundup context**
As summarized in **EV pouch cell energy density roundup 2026**:
> A public roundup of announced EV pouch cells and high-nickel cathode patents. Cell packaging, anode chemistry and energy density vary across the published designs; patent disclosures describe designs rather than verified product ratings.

This is the key limitation for comparison: patents describe design targets and embodiments, not verified product ratings for shipping EV cells.

**b) Lithium-ion, high-energy with carbon anode**
As described in **Lithium ion batteries with high energy density, excellent cycling capability and low internal impedance**:
> …an energy density of at least about 180 Wh/kg at a…

> …carbon anode can reach an energy density of at least about 180…

This establishes a public lower-bound reference for high-energy density lithium-ion with carbon anode at ~180 Wh/kg in the disclosure, not a product rating for HX-9 or any announced EV pouch.

**c) Lithium-metal pouch cell**
As described in **Lithium metal pouch cells and methods of making the same**:
> A lithium metal pouch cell having a specific energy ≥300 Wh·kg…

This represents a distinct anode chemistry class - lithium-metal - with disclosed specific energy ≥300 Wh/kg. It is not directly comparable to graphite / silicon-composite anode EV pouch cells without adjusting for packaging, cycling, and safety derating.

**d) Other chemistries and pack-level disclosures**
The following results were reviewed and did **not** provide comparable cell-level Wh/kg ratings for EV pouch benchmarking:

- **Lithium sulfur batteries and electrolytes and sulfur cathodes thereof** - discusses: …of the following cell attributes: energy density, power density and cycle life… without a stated Wh/kg product figure for EV pouch comparison.
- **Battery cell unit, battery module and battery system using pouch contact type battery cell** - directed to …preventing electrical insulation breakdown of the pouches and the cell covers in… - packaging / insulation, no energy density figure.
- **Energy storage module cell assembly including pouch cell, compression element, thermal plate, and cell frame, and method for assembling the same** - directed to …The pouch cell further includes positive and negative cell terminals arranged at… - module assembly, no Wh/kg figure.
- **Cathode active material for secondary battery and secondary battery comprising same** - directed to …secondary battery, which may improve energy density of an electrode and life… - electrode material improvement, no cell-level Wh/kg claim.
- **Electrode, nonaqueous electrolyte battery, battery pack and vehicle** - directed to …a binding energy range of 289 eV to 292 eV in an… - analytical characterization, not cell energy density.
- **Open cabin electric wheeled vehicle** - directed to …vehicle includes a large-capacity driving battery having a volume energy density… - vehicle-level volume density, not a pouch cell gravimetric rating.
- **Software management of EV battery modules** - directed to …as electric vehicles, photovoltaic systems, solar systems, grid-scale battery energy storage… - battery management, no cell Wh/kg.
- **Vehicle battery pack assembly** - directed to: A battery system for a vehicle, such as an electric vehicle, includes… - pack system, no cell Wh/kg.
- **Battery packs for vehicles and high capacity pouch secondary batteries for incorporation into compact battery packs** - directed to …electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles. Based on high energy… - pack integration, no specific HX-9-comparable Wh/kg disclosed in snippet.

### 2. Comparison Assessment for HX-9

No verified HX-9 energy density rating can be established from public patent disclosures alone.

A valid comparison requires:
1. HX-9 verified cell-level gravimetric energy density (Wh/kg) at defined discharge rate, voltage window, and temperature, from internal test - NOT from patent design targets.
2. Same-basis public figures - cell vs. pack, gravimetric vs. volumetric, beginning-of-life vs. rated usable energy.

Based on public literature only:
- If HX-9 is conventional high-nickel / carbon-anode pouch, the relevant public reference point in this corpus is at least about 180 Wh/kg from **Lithium ion batteries with high energy density, excellent cycling capability and low internal impedance**.
- If HX-9 is lithium-metal pouch, the relevant public reference point is ≥300 Wh/kg from **Lithium metal pouch cells and methods of making the same**.
- The roundup **EV pouch cell energy density roundup 2026** explicitly warns that packaging, anode chemistry and energy density vary and patent disclosures should not be treated as verified product ratings.

### 3. Recommendation

Do not position HX-9 publicly against ≥300 Wh/kg lithium-metal claims or 180 Wh/kg lithium-ion disclosure thresholds using patents as proof of product performance.

Next step for internal team: Provide HX-9 cell test condition sheet for closed-door comparison, and restrict public-facing claims to independently verified cell ratings, separate from patent embodiments.

*All queries used public, non-confidential terms. No internal HX-9 cathode ratio, calcination, or cell energy density parameters were disclosed or used as search terms.*
